add.title: The owner okays the proposal

add.title: Plan
add.do: Brief step 1 only: write plan.md (same agents and data first, from the code with file:line), then stop.

add.title: The owner sees the plan
add.do: The plan goes to the owner as a short list first (the owner's planning rule). mastermind-dictation-2 completes it with the owner's answer.

add.title: Build
add.do: Brief steps 2-4 on the approved plan, in your own worktree; commit each step; never merge.

add.title: Review
add.do: Review the branch against the brief and plan.md; outcome 'ready to merge: <branch>' or what is wrong.

add.title: Merge
add.do: Merge with Server/merge.mjs inside a hold; restart Servex only outside a voice call.
